name: Thunderaan
summary: In Silithus, Thunderaan's scattered bindings may open the way to his return. Ragnaros struck down the Prince of Air and sealed away the essence he could not consume. Highlord Demitrian waits for those who recover both halves.

sections.title: The Elemental Sundering
sections.body: During the Elemental Sundering, fire and air warred deep within Azeroth for five thousand years. Ragnaros sought Thunderaan's destruction and power. Baron Geddon and Garr, his lieutenants, ambushed and betrayed the Prince. Then Ragnaros struck him down with Sulfuras, the Firelord's hammer. Thunderaan's essence was too mighty for Ragnaros to consume in full.

sections.title: The Shattered Talisman
sections.body: Ragnaros could not devour all of the Prince of Air's essence. He sealed what remained in a talisman of elemental binding, then shattered it into two flawless halves so Thunderaan could not reform. Baron Geddon received one half and Garr the other. Both were hidden in the volcanic depths of the Molten Core beneath Blackrock Mountain.

sections.title: Rebirth in Silithus
sections.body: Highlord Demitrian, an eccentric hermit allied with the Twilight's Hammer in Silithus's arid dunes, performs a ritual when both binding fragments are brought to him. The ritual manifests Thunderaan, the Prince of Air, and his fury brings the summoners to battle. His legendary blade is Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker.

faq.answer: Thunderaan is the Prince of Air, a noble and devastating elemental lord aligned with the wind. Ragnaros overwhelmed him long ago and sealed away the essence that remained.

During the Elemental Sundering, Baron Geddon and Garr betrayed Thunderaan alongside Ragnaros. Ragnaros crushed the Prince with Sulfuras and consumed part of his essence, but could not digest it all. He sealed the remainder in a talisman split in two.

faq.q: Where are the pieces of his binding held?
aliases: where are bindings of the windseeker
faq.answer: Garr and Baron Geddon hold the two flawless halves of Thunderaan's binding deep inside the Molten Core beneath Blackrock Mountain.

faq.q: Why is Highlord Demitrian in Silithus involved?
faq.answer: Highlord Demitrian, allied with the Twilight's Hammer in Silithus, knows the arts needed to reconstitute the shattered talisman and summon the Prince of Air into Azeroth.

faq.q: What happens when Thunderaan is summoned in Silithus?
faq.answer: Demitrian performs a dangerous ritual with the recovered bindings. What emerges becomes clear when the ritual is complete.

faq.q: What weapon is tied to Thunderaan?
faq.answer: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker, is the legendary sword tied to the Prince of Air. Demitrian's ritual reveals its fate.

angles.text: As a shaman, you know Thunderaan as a pure and wrathful embodiment of air and lightning, and a spiritual custodian of the elements.
As a warrior, you seek the legend of Thunderfury, the storm-infused sword associated with the Prince of Air.
As a rogue, you covet the Prince of Air's fallen essence, bound within Thunderfury, for its unmatched speed and lightning-quick combat.
